hook.rumour: Between the Tower of Dawn and Tower of Dusk at Ghostgate, Buoyant Armigers and Ordinators report that three bone-pylons along the Ghostfence have begun to hum in dissonance with Dagoth Ur's ash-storms.
hook.notice: GHOSTGATE CITADEL COMMAND — Veteran volunteers required to inspect the bone-pylons along Foyada Ashur-Dan and purge the Sixth House resonators inside the Ghostfence.
hook.context: Red Mountain is the blighted volcanic heart of Vvardenfell, encircled by the glowing blue Ghostfence built from the consecrated bones of Dunmer ancestors.

quests.title: Bone and Blue Fire at Ghostgate

stages.objective: Report to the Armiger captain in the Tower of Dusk at Ghostgate
Inspect the cracked ancestral bone-pylon along the Ghostfence perimeter
Clear the ash-ghoul scouting party advancing down Foyada Ashur-Dan

objectives.text: Report to the Armiger captain in the Tower of Dusk at Ghostgate
Inspect the cracked ancestral bone-pylon along the Ghostfence perimeter
Clear the ash-ghoul scouting party advancing down Foyada Ashur-Dan

consequence_detail.summary: The cracked pylon along the Ghostfence is stabilized temporarily, and ash-tuning spikes found in Foyada Ashur-Dan point to Falensarano and Mzanchend.

stages.objective: Follow the ash-storm ridge through the Valley of the Wind
Retrieve the Dwemer grounding-rod from the steam-galleries of Mzanchend
Defeat the Ascended Sleeper relay-keeper atop the stronghold of Falensarano

objectives.text: Follow the ash-storm ridge through the Valley of the Wind
Retrieve the Dwemer grounding-rod from the steam-galleries of Mzanchend
Defeat the Ascended Sleeper relay-keeper atop the stronghold of Falensarano

consequence_detail.summary: The Dwemer grounding-rod is recovered from Mzanchend and the relay-keeper at Falensarano is destroyed.

stages.objective: Ascend the basalt gorge of Foyada Esannudan inside the Ghostfence
Shatter the secondary ash-harmonic bells mounted in the ruins of Nchuleft
Slay the Dagoth heart-priest conducting the blight-storm on the rim of Red Mountain

objectives.text: Ascend the basalt gorge of Foyada Esannudan inside the Ghostfence
Shatter the secondary ash-harmonic bells mounted in the ruins of Nchuleft
Slay the Dagoth heart-priest conducting the blight-storm on the rim of Red Mountain

consequence_detail.summary: The Dagoth heart-priest on Red Mountain's rim is slain and the harmonic bells threatening the Ghostfence are shattered.

stages.objective: Drive the Dwemer grounding-rod into the repaired bone-pylon at the Ghostfence
Return the consecrated ancestor-casket to the reliquary of Ghostgate
Receive the Salute of the Two Towers from the Armigers and Ordinators at Ghostgate

objectives.text: Drive the Dwemer grounding-rod into the repaired bone-pylon at the Ghostfence
Return the consecrated ancestor-casket to the reliquary of Ghostgate
Receive the Salute of the Two Towers from the Armigers and Ordinators at Ghostgate

consequence_detail.summary: The Ghostfence bone-pylon burns bright blue once more, holding back the blight-winds above Ghostgate.
